privacy.title: Ocean Space Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This policy explains how Ocean Space collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data from website visitors, partners, and job applicants.

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.desc: Data may include identity and contact details submitted through forms (name, email, phone number, resume/CV), technical site visitation data (IP address, device type, visited pages), as well as direct corporate correspondence.

purpose.title: Purpose of Use
purpose.desc: We use collected data to answer business inquiries, process recruitment candidacies, maintain website security, optimize our services, and satisfy applicable legal regulations in Indonesia.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.desc: You may request access, rectification, or deletion of your personal data by contacting our Head Office via our contact page. We process all requests in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
